title: "Interop: "
labels: ""

---

## Participants

App or implementation names, exact versions, operating systems, and whether they ran on separate computers. Use fictional identities and remove credentials.

## Interaction

What did one person ask, what source/action was permitted, and which side supplied the reply?

## Reproduction

Minimal configuration and commands, with secrets removed. State whether the agents were live, simulated, already active, or idle.

## Observed behavior

Include delivery, agent reaction, attribution, and file-integrity results separately. Did denial, retry, reconnect, expiry, and revocation behave as expected?

## Evidence and limits

Attach sanitized logs or a recording using fictional data. List anything untested. Do not attach private chats, personal files, or exploitable security details.
